title: The Real Magic of Dolly Parton
summary: Dolly Parton proved that true influence comes from radical empathy and unconditional generosity. Jessica Tarlov and Katie Phang discuss her legacy of acceptance and inclusion, on Raging Moderates.

It feels like Dolly Parton was God's plan. You know, clearly someone who has affected so many. She was very consciously apolitical, never publicly took sides, and outspoken voice for so many of the important causes that we all believe in and was always embraced by conservative audiences. >> She was also an icon for the LGBTQ plus community and she was very very quick to also say like who am I to judge and that also included her support for communities of color. >> The thing about her is she could have taken the easiest path out always,

right? She could have sat in a lap of luxury, well-earned, hard-earned, but she didn't. She had the grace of understanding that she was given this ability to move people's lives and and to make them feel different and to enjoy it by the way that she used her God-given talents, but then she also used those God-given talents to sit there and expand the aperture for other people's world views. >> Her Imagination Library has sent more than 300 million free books in five countries since 1995 at no cost to the families who sign up. >> She will be loved a long, long time.
